$comment: Per-game data the rare.market catalog does not carry: where a web game actually plays, how the controller maps, and where native builds come from. Keyed by the catalog slug. Read by the UI (src/games) and compiled into the native side (src-tauri/src/library/profiles.rs). input: gamepad = the page reads the standard Gamepad API, Rare exposes a virtual pad with analog sticks and sends no keys; keys = buttons become keyboard events, the right stick drives a pointer. browser: chrome = the page needs features WebKitGTK lacks, open it in a Chromium browser.

act.controls: Left stick moves, right stick aims, triggers fire and aim. Buttons can be rebound in ACT's settings.

pawtato-land.controls: D-pad moves between the game's buttons, A presses. Explore Without Account starts as a guest.

cosmocadia.controls: Left stick walks (WASD), right stick moves the pointer, RB clicks.

aresrpg.controls: Right stick moves the pointer, RB clicks. Menu presses Enter (the game starts on Enter), B is Escape. Sign in with Google or connect Rare Wallet.

suuuiplash.unavailable: Suuuiplash has no web build yet; its page is a trailer and app download.

pebble-city.unavailable: Pebble City's web page is offline right now.

doubleup.controls: Right stick moves the pointer, RB clicks. DoubleUp blocks some regions.

suifrens.controls: D-pad moves between buttons, A presses. Connect Wallet lists Rare Wallet.

native.how: Get it free on the Epic Games Store. Sign in to Epic in Heroic (Desktop mode, Discover) and install it there; it shows up here when installed.
Download the Windows launcher from evefrontier.com and add it to Steam as a non-Steam game with Proton, or copy the installed game into ~/Games. It shows up here once installed.
Install it from Steam. It runs through Proton.
